method: MSU-LatentAFIS enhancement autoencoder (E05's network, Model.reconstruction2), trained on our damaged -> clean pairs in the MSU-normalised domain (v3 train set)
_normalization: input = fpr.data.normalization.normalize(degraded) (the evaluator's own normalisation, texture sigma 2.5); target = the normalised clean print; output measured as stored (evaluate.py --rec-normalized)

model._source: E05_msu_aec/model.py (MSU Model.reconstruction2), unchanged: 0.65M parameters, no skip connections

training.data: NormPairs (pairs.py) = FixedTrainDataset(normalized=True) windows on v3: 6,308 crops x 6 contaminants x 3 copies = 113,544 samples
training._source: batch (in windows), patch, optimiser and L2 loss as E05 (MSU's recipe); only the training pairs change. 30k steps instead of E05's 50k, and 8 windows per loaded sample (16 samples x 8 = 128 windows a step): PNG loading, not the 0.65M-parameter network, set the speed (1 s a step with one window per sample, 2026-10-23 job 362303)

sweep._note: sweep.py repairs v3 val both ways and keeps the higher net rescue (score 1), ties -> higher ridge fidelity; false is the baselines' agreed protocol (whole print)
